sn13.6:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, mahāpaṭhavi parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya ṭhapetvā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā.
sn13.6:1.4: katamannu kho bahutaraṃ yaṃ vā mahāpaṭhaviyā parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ, yā vā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā avasiṭṭhāti?
sn13.6:2.1: etadeva bhante bahutaraṃ mahāpaṭhaviyā yadidaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ.
sn13.6:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upenti, na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti, na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti, mahāpaṭhaviyā parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā avasiṭṭhāti.
